summary: Validated referral unlock/share change-set end-to-end (backend + frontend). Register now creates immediate referral link, referral credit is granted on anonymous P13 with referral_code, self-referral does not credit, legacy blocked/no-code accounts are auto-migrated by GET /api/referral/me, Home uses floating-referral-share-button and logged-out click redirects to /entrar, and Meus Pedidos shows ReferralCard ready/unblocked with link and share actions.
critical_code_review_comments: Referral code generation (gen_referral_code) has no DB uniqueness guarantee/index. Collision risk is low but non-zero; consider unique index on users.referral_code with retry-on-duplicate insert/update.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; no hardcoded seeded credential was used for core assertions.
seed_data_creation: Temporary test users/orders/sessions/events/ledger only. Backend pytest fixture cleanup executed; additional Mongo cleanup removed UI-created referral test user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest run command used: source backend/.env + frontend/.env then pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_referral_unlock_share.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration5.xml. Frontend was validated against public URL https://santafe-deposito.preview.emergentagent.com with Playwright automation. No MOCKED API used.
